hero_tagline: Universal data converter — fast, local, nothing extra
settings_auto_preview_desc: Open file preview after conversion is complete
settings_archive_desc: Pack the converted file into an archive
settings_show_extensions_desc: Show extensions in the list (data.json instead of data)
settings_security_desc: All data is processed locally. No data is transmitted to the server.
settings_save_message: Settings are saved automatically on your device
format_desc_json: JavaScript Object Notation — lightweight data interchange format based on JavaScript syntax
format_desc_yaml: YAML Ain't Markup Language — human-readable data serialization format, popular in configs and DevOps
format_desc_csv: Comma-Separated Values — tabular format for storing and exchanging data between databases, Excel and analytics
format_desc_xml: Extensible Markup Language — universal markup language with tree structure, widely used in APIs, SOAP and configs
format_desc_toml: Tom's Obvious Minimal Language — minimalistic config format with clear structure, Rust community favorite
format_desc_ini: Simplest configuration file format with sections and key-value pairs, used everywhere
format_desc_md: Lightweight markup language for text formatting, converts to HTML, PDF and other formats
format_desc_html: HyperText Markup Language — standard web markup language, foundation of all web pages and templates
